title: Module 1: Internal Forces and Shear-Moment Diagrams
description: Use the section-and-replace logic to find internal normal force, shear, and bending moment at any beam cross section, and build shear and moment diagrams using the load-shear-moment slope relations.
learning_objectives: Apply section-and-replace logic to compute internal N, V, and M at any cross section of a beam.
Use a consistent sign convention so left-side and right-side free bodies tell the same physical story.
Construct shear and moment diagrams using dV/dx = -w and dM/dx = V, including jumps at point loads and couples.
Locate the position and value of maximum bending moment by finding where V crosses zero.
